description: A strip marker removes typographic spaces such as en, em, thin and hair spaces
notes: The spec says strip markers remove spaces, "interpreted as per Unicode's definition", without saying which definition it means. The en, em, thin and hair spaces (U+2002, U+2003, U+2009, U+200A) are space separators (category Zs) with the White_Space property, but not in Pattern_White_Space, the set Unicode recommends for syntax (UAX #31). Stripping them is hashicorp/hcl's reading: parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go trims with Go's unicode.IsSpace, which follows the White_Space property.
